items.t: Alternator can short internally and overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace alternator
items.note: Free under recall 02V-171. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Ignition coils fail and cause misfires
items.job: Replace ignition coils (set of 6) and spark plugs
items.note: Rear bank coils sit under the intake plenum, which adds labor.

items.t: Front lower control arm pin can break at the frame (recall)
items.job: Replace both front transverse links (lower control arms)
items.note: Free under recall 02V-146. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Gas pedal can travel too far and limit engine speed (recall)
items.job: Install updated accelerator pedal stopper
items.note: Free under recall 02V-043. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Crank or cam position sensor can cut out and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace crankshaft and camshaft position sensors
items.note: Free under recall 03V-455. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Glass roof panel can shatter (recall)
items.job: Replace Skyview roof glass panel
items.note: Free under recall 04V-326. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver seat wiring can short and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace and reroute driver seat lumbar harness
items.note: Free under recall 05V-512. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifts harshly or slips
items.job: Rebuild or replace automatic transmission
items.note: A valve body repair or fluid service costs far less if caught early.

items.t: Timing chain guides and tensioner wear and whine
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Water pump is usually replaced at the same time.

items.t: Rear subframe bracket can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace rear subframe
items.note: Free under recall 06V-046. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering column can lock while the car is moving (recall)
items.job: Replace steering wheel lock assembly
items.note: Free under recall 06V-402. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front strut mounts can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace both front strut insulators (mounts)
items.note: Free under recall 09V-358. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Electronic steering lock fails and the car will not start
items.job: Replace electronic steering column lock unit

items.t: Front brake caliper bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten front brake caliper mounting bolts
items.note: Free under recall 15V-733. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel tank seal may leak in a crash (recall)
items.job: Install fuel sending unit retainer ring
items.note: Free under recall 15V-486. Check the VIN first.

items.t: ABS unit seal can fail and reduce brake pressure (recall)
items.job: Replace ABS actuator
items.note: Free under recall 16V-193. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Forward emergency braking warning from the front radar sensor
items.job: Diagnose and realign or replace front radar sensor
items.note: Low end is a realignment only; high end includes a new sensor and calibration.

items.t: Passenger airbag may be switched off by mistake (recall)
items.job: Reprogram airbag and occupant classification control units
items.note: Free under recall 16V-244. Check the VIN first.

items.t: ABS unit can leak brake fluid inside and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Replace ABS actuator
items.note: Free under recall 19V-807. Check the VIN first.

items.t: CVT shudders or vibrates
items.job: Replace CVT valve body or CVT assembly
items.note: Low end is a valve body; high end is a complete CVT.

items.t: Ticking or popping from behind the rear seat
items.job: Adjust rear body panel gap and add foam filler

items.t: Backup camera image can be hidden by a saved setting (recall)
items.job: Update backup camera display software
items.note: Free under recall 19V-654. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear window glass may not be bonded properly (recall)
items.job: Remove and reinstall or replace rear window glass
items.note: Free under recall 20V-570. Check the VIN first.
